content.user_title: Audit paid advertising accounts before scaling
content.value_statement: Paid advertising decisions can rely on inflated attribution, incomplete measurement, or unsafe placements. This skill reviews exported evidence against a structured ROAS framework and returns a clear gate decision.
actual_capabilities: Collects required account context, including currency, attribution window, conversion lag, and business constraints.
Scores 20 ROAS criteria across audience, offer, return, and spend efficiency.
Separates platform-reported results from normalized own-data outcome evidence.
Flags verified measurement, attribution, claims, policy, and placement-safety vetoes.
Returns SHIP, FIX, BLOCK, or UNDECIDED outcomes based on evidence coverage and scoring.
Produces prioritized fixes with owners and rerun conditions without changing account settings.
limitations: It evaluates evidence supplied by the user and cannot independently verify missing exports or source systems.
It does not enable campaigns, edit bids, upload audiences, or change advertising budgets.
It does not replace legal, platform-policy, finance, or experimental-design review.
Standalone installs may collect observations but cannot calculate a score or persist an audit artifact.

use_cases.title: Approve budget growth
use_cases.description: Review measurement and incrementality evidence before increasing spend on a paid-media portfolio.

use_cases.title: Investigate weak ROAS
use_cases.description: Identify likely attribution, duplication, placement, or economics issues in an underperforming account.

use_cases.title: Prepare an audit handoff
use_cases.description: Create an evidence-based account review with gaps, priorities, owners, and rerun conditions.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this paid advertising account for direct response. I will provide campaign exports, conversion data, currency, attribution window, conversion lag, and CAC limit.

prompt_templates.title: Check launch readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this account before launch. Use the direct-response profile and identify any missing evidence, verified vetoes, and the correct SHIP, FIX, BLOCK, or UNDECIDED outcome.

prompt_templates.title: Assess incrementality
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this portfolio with the incremental-profit profile. Compare the holdout results and deduplicated order-ID exports against the stated margin, payback, attribution window, and conversion lag.

prompt_templates.title: Request an executive report
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a complete ROAS audit using the supplied exports. Present business impact, evidence quality, 20-item scoring, verified controls, unknowns, prioritized owners, and a rerun condition. Do not change account settings.

output_examples.input: A direct-response account has normalized order IDs and a 7-day click window, but no placement report.
output: Reason: Placement safety evidence is missing, so A1 remains Unknown.
Next step: Provide the placement report before a final gate decision.

output_examples.input: An account has a strong reported ROAS but verified duplicate conversion counting.
output: Reason: A verified attribution inflation failure affects return measurement.
Next step: Correct conversion deduplication and rerun the audit with normalized outcomes.

output_examples.input: An account has complete evidence, a raw score of 78, and no verified vetoes.
output: Result: The evidence supports the declared direct-response profile.
Next step: Continue monitoring against the documented business constraint.

best_practices: Provide normalized exports with dates, IDs, currency, attribution windows, and conversion lag.
Use own-data outcomes and holdout evidence when available instead of relying only on platform reporting.
Treat missing required evidence as Unknown and resolve it before making scaling decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not treat platform-reported ROAS as proof of incremental profit.
Do not compare channels before normalizing currency, windows, lag, and outcome IDs.
Do not change campaigns or budgets based on an audit without separate explicit approval.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide delivery, spend, conversion, economics, attribution, placement, and change-history exports when available.

faq.question: Can this skill change my advertising account?
faq.answer: No. It is an assessment skill and does not enable campaigns, change bids, upload audiences, or scale budgets.

faq.question: What happens when evidence is missing?
faq.answer: The skill marks the related item as Unknown and may return UNDECIDED instead of inferring a result.

faq.question: Does a high ROAS guarantee a SHIP result?
faq.answer: No. The audit also checks measurement integrity, incrementality, safety, claims, policy, and operating quality.

faq.question: What does BLOCK mean?
faq.answer: BLOCK means a required control has a verified failure, such as material attribution inflation or a safety breach.

faq.question: Can it assess incremental profit?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide a suitable holdout, geo split, or causal-test evidence and declared business constraints.
